Glossary · Study database

Study database: all sources behind the fact check

Here are all 3480 studies that our 535 topic, tip, comparison and question pages rely on, with original title, year, study type and the pages where we use them. Below follow 744 sources from authorities, law and professional societies.

The study type comes from the PubMed and Europe PMC databases and is a guide, not a quality grade. A large randomized trial carries more weight than a small one, and an animal study says nothing yet about humans. What this means for a topic is explained on the respective page and in the BK-Score.
